newsitem.title: USA: U.S. supports African regional parley next week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. supports African regional parley next week.

text.p: The United States on Friday threw its weight behind a regional conference due to be held in Nairobi next Tuesday which is expected to discuss the worsening fighting in eastern Zaire.

Kenyan state radio said on Thursday that leaders of Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, Rwanda, Ethiopia and Cameroon had been invited to the conference, although it did not specifically spell out that Zaire would be the main topic.

"The United States supports this call for a regional conference," State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns said, adding that it would include the United Nations and interested Western countries including the United States.
The fighting pits Zaire's army and allied Rwandan Hutu fighters against well-armed Tutsi rebels in the eastern provinces of North and South Kivu facing Rwanda and Burundi.
The United States has made so far ineffectual efforts to persuade Zairean and Rwandan leaders to talk to each other, but had said the diplomatic lead must come from the United Nations.

Burns charged that the Tutsi-led Rwandan army had intervened in the fighting "and at least at one point a couple of days ago, certainly crossed the border into Zaire, which was not advisable and was not a smart thing to do."

"We have made a very clear demarche to the Rwandan government that it ought to restrain its own military which is only adding to the complexity and the difficulty that has produced this fighting," he told a new briefing.

But Burns said he could not confirm reports from diplomats in Rwanda that Rwandan troops had again intervened on Friday and entered the embattled eastern Zaire city of Goma. Those reports were denied by the Rwandan government.

Burns said 10 American missionaries were among people trapped in Bukavu, a town in the war zone. U.S. officials were attempting to communicate with them to advise them on how best to protect themselves.
The U.S. spokesman was unable to identify the missionaries or say which church they represented.
